title: rhododendron catawbiense f. album
intro: Rhododendron catawbiense f. album, commonly known as the Catawba White Rhododendron, is a flowering plant species belonging to the heath family (Ericaceae). It is a variety of Rhododendron catawbiense, known for its pure white, fragrant flowers and compact growth habit. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Rhododendron catawbiense f. album include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
